entities.summary: Joseph Chatt was a renowned British researcher in the area of inorganic and organometallic chemistry. His name is associated with the description of the pi-bond between transition metals and alkenes, the Dewar–Chatt–Duncanson model. Joseph Chatt was a scientists & inventors from Horden (1914-11-06, Horden–1994-05-19). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
